_setup: Create a free tenant at auth0.com.
Applications > Create > Single Page Application. Note the Domain and Client ID.
Add http://localhost:3000/callback to Allowed Callback URLs.
Applications > APIs > Create an API with identifier https://api.example.com. Its
identifier is the `audience` below, and without it Auth0 hands back an opaque token.
Applications > Create > Machine to Machine, authorise it for that API, for `service`.
Auth0 does not enable the password grant by default, so the user flow needs `form`
